This seat cannot read the PurchaseOrder entity. `seat_capability` for `PurchaseOrder.list` returned `outside_seat: true` (REST 403 — the entity exists on the platform but is not granted to this seat). So I have no PO number and no expected receipt date for the materials on WO-2026-00001, and I won't guess one. Someone with purchasing/procurement access needs to pull that.

- **Contributing:** the order is `not_started` past its planned start (2026-06-10), 56 days past its planned end (2026-08-24) as of today 2026-10-19.
